response.sql: SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_track_price, (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) as overall_avg_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) as ratio FROM MediaType mt LEFT JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
